messages:
Evan: quick heads-up — we need to create release/1.16.0 branch tomorrow morning; who's owning origination + initial changelog? tagging @Samara @Leo
Samara: I can own origination, will create branch after CI green. What cutoff time are we using?
Evan: target cutoff 2026-04-01 08:00 PT. After that only critical/backport-by-approval. Also, we want to batch small docs-only PRs into a single cherry-pick to avoid noise :shrug:
Leo: For backport eligibility, are we doing the 2-week window (PR merged into main within last 14 days)?
Samara: that's the default, yes. Exceptions require PM/eng lead + release-sheriff signoff.
Evan: also, please add a changelog entry under 'Unreleased' with component tag — I'll run the script:
Evan: ```
./scripts/new-release-branch.sh 1.16.0
git push origin release/1.16.0
```
Release-bot: deploy-checklist invoked — remember to update release-notes.md and assign release-owner. :white_check_mark:
Irina: small ask — if you plan cherry-picks, add the backport label and include the original PR number in the PR title e.g. "(backport #1234)" so automation picks it up.
Samara: noted. Do we still allow "batch-cherry" where multiple fixes are combined? Thinking of queueing small fixes into one backport PR to reduce CI churn.
Evan: yes but only for docs or non-API changes; combine up to 3 related fixes. Call it out in PR body.
Leo: who's on deck to merge the branch creation PR and run smoke tests? I can do merge + smoke between 08:00-09:00 PT.
Samara: thanks. I'll open the branch PR at 07:45 so you're ready.
Evan: perfect. I'll update the release calendar and ping infra for extra canary capacity. :rocket:
Leo: one more — if we need to revert a backport, use `git revert -m 1` and ping release-sre.
Samara: thanks — I'll add a short checklist in the PR template.
Evan: awesome, thanks team :tada:
